recipedb3.licence: CoSyLab/RecipeDB3 public notebook data; use per D-015 (ASSUMED / DERIVED_ONLY); text not redistributed here

split_rules.recipedb3: sha256 bucket of the masked-sentence family: test <0.10, dev <0.20, CALIBRATION <0.30, train rest
split_rules.tasteset: legacy recipe split (seed 7, 70/15/15); train recipes byte-identical to a dev/test recipe quarantined; 12.5% grouped CALIBRATION carved from train

calibration_split_rule: never used to fit encoder, calibrator, aliases, gazetteer or linker; thresholds are set on CALIBRATION only; calibrators are fit out-of-fold on train (5-fold)
dev_rule: model/checkpoint selection only; max dev exact micro F1 on the primary view; ties -> earlier epoch; test never read during selection
train_only_statistics: alias hits, surface frequencies, strata, gazetteers and linker indices are built from train; train-time features are 5-fold out-of-fold; test uses the full-train build; candidate spans (all n-grams <= 6 tokens) are generated before NER

list: head/mid/tail/unseen surface F1 (train counts; head>=20, tail<=4)

seed_semantics: model-initialisation/shuffle seeds only; the split never changes
checkpoint_selection: max dev exact micro F1 on the primary view; ties -> earlier epoch; test never read during selection

statistics.ci: paired grouped bootstrap 95% (groups = split groups), CI must exclude 0

pareto_promotion_rule.gain: delta exact micro F1 >= 0.003 and Holm-adjusted CI excludes 0 (or delta >= 0 with strictly lower cost and better calibration)
pareto_promotion_rule.macro_robustness: exact macro F1 must not fall by more than 0.003
pareto_promotion_rule.tail_unseen: tail and unseen-surface F1 must not fall by more than 0.005
pareto_promotion_rule.calibration: ECE must not rise by more than 0.01 (when a confidence is produced)
pareto_promotion_rule.cost: inference latency <= 2x previous rung unless delta exact micro F1 >= 0.01

router.thresholds: set by risk control on CALIBRATION so ACCEPT-set error <= epsilon, stratified by label and line type; epsilon declared before the first run: 0.02

fusion_guards.feature_roles: encoder confidence/entropy are calibrator-only (excluded from fusion inputs)

claims_policy: no SOTA / superiority claim before H6; no test-set model selection; benchmark is not modified after any candidate sees test
